set.body: Scope: revised PRD Phase 2. Introduce pure ArchiveRevision and publication state, resource-backed OpenArchive[F], typed PayloadExecutor, structural versus content validation, and common receipt adaptation over current eager LNA-HDF5 and Zarr paths. Use the Phase-1 axis-keyed capability and receipt-conformance contracts. Acceptance: valid unknown representations remain inspectable; incomplete publication differs from unsupported representation; eager HDF5 reports WholePayload for the relevant axes; Zarr retains exact object/range/byte evidence; mixed time/sample claims conform to receipts; success, failure, and cancellation close resources; the frozen compatibility corpus remains green on JVM and Scala.js.
